# Partners in Literacy Haiti (PILH)

> A 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 87-0904773) building children's libraries in
> rural Haiti with Kreyòl books, technology, and teacher training, for
> children from birth to eight years old. Founded 2011, incorporated 2021.
> Candid Platinum Transparency Seal holder. Site available in English (/en),
> Haitian Kreyòl (/ht), French (/fr) and Spanish (/es).

Key facts: more than 3,000 Kreyòl books placed in children's hands; five
village libraries mentored across three departments (Ouest, Centre,
Artibonite); 98 schools supplied with alphabet charts and books; 3,800
students reached through teacher training. Flagship project: the Duplan
Methodist Community Library, Ouest. Publisher of six Kreyòl easy readers and
the Alfabè Kreyòl Mwen alphabet chart (MIT Haiti Initiative verified,
US Library of Congress registered).

Donations are processed by Zeffy, which passes one hundred percent of each
gift to PILH; receipts are tax deductible in the United States. Checks:
Partners in Literacy Haiti, P.O. Box 90057, Indianapolis, IN 46290-0057, USA.

- [How we work](https://haiti-literacy.vercel.app/en/our-work): the three part model
- [The Duplan project](https://haiti-literacy.vercel.app/en/duplan): flagship library

- [The numbers](https://haiti-literacy.vercel.app/en/statistics): sourced education statistics for Haiti
- [Contact](https://haiti-literacy.vercel.app/en/contact): for donors, educators in Haiti, and partners
